obligations.behavior: Compute centered cross-channel window sums across L in {3, 5, 7, 9} for single-lane INT16 (37-bit) and dual-lane INT8 (2x21-bit packed) with exact 2-stage load-enabled pipeline alignment inside NV_NVDLA_CDP_DP_sum.

Generate elastic LE (65-entry exponential/linear) and LO (257-entry linear) LUT indices and 16-bit fractions across INT8, INT16, and FP16 modes, strictly clamping NaN/<=0 to underflow (index 0) and +Inf/above-range to overflow (index 64/256).

Execute elastic FP16 and signed integer piecewise-linear interpolation with symmetric round-half-away-from-zero right-shift, left-shift, signed 16-bit saturation [-32768, +32767] (sign-extended to 17-bit interp_out_pd), and bit-exact NV_NVDLA_CDP_dp multi-cube output/telemetry parity.

Synthesize all 3 units latch-free and loop-free in Yosys, pass 4-state gate-level reset/X-hygiene simulation, meet Nangate45 cell area caps (int_sum_block <= 6100 um^2, LUT_CTRL <= 27500 um^2, 3-unit total <= 59000 um^2), and close OpenROAD 3.80 ns setup STA (WNS >= 0.0 ns).
